# Project

A Genesis application: a React frontend, a FastAPI backend, and Postgres, assembled from
modules. Everything auto-wires by convention — there are no registration lists to edit.

## What is installed

| Module | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| admin | User management and a DB-backed permission system, behind an isolated /admin panel |
| ai | Multi-provider LLM calls (LiteLLM) |
| analytics | In-process SQL over Postgres (DuckDB) |
| auth | Email/password login and session verification (bcrypt + JWT, no sidecar service) |
| cache | Key/value cache (Valkey) |
| email | Send email (SMTP, console backend for local dev) |
| jobs | Durable background jobs (Temporal) |
| rag | Embeddings + pgvector similarity search (RAG building blocks) |
| realtime | WebSocket pub/sub (in-process locally, Valkey fanout across workers) |
| storage | File storage / uploads (local disk, S3-compatible in production) |

## Size

| Thing | Count |
| --- | --- |
| Database tables | 4 |
| Request/response shapes | 19 |
| Endpoint files | 9 |
| Routes | 22 |
| Background tasks | 1 |
| Frontend pages | 7 |

## Run it

```bash
manage dev      # build and start at http://localhost:8000
manage down     # stop
manage logs     # follow logs
```

See `ARCHITECTURE.md` for how a request flows, `AI_CONTEXT.md` for where to put new code.
